game_title: Flowchart Lab · Sum from 1 to n
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Dry Well, a nearly dry well: the sand ranger must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dry Well: a nearly dry well
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Add all whole numbers from 1 through n, then display the total. For n = 0, display 0. Test dataset 8: {'n': 0}; {'n': 13}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Refactor Rescue' (Week 9 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Dry Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 70 points of sand maps by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 70, or lives reach 0.
hint: Coordinates begin at the top left. Walls block movement. Use int declarations, observe(value), movement calls, and { } for local scope.
